entry_state: Seen from about two metres behind at chest height, the crisply folded white airplane glides nose first down the middle of the long sunlit corridor: glossy light-grey floor with sunlight stripes, ivory wall with wooden doors on the LEFT, a row of tall windows on the RIGHT showing green treetops.
beats: Continuing the reference video without any cut, the camera keeps following steadily from behind as the airplane glides on along the corridor at chest-to-eye height, well above the floor; through the tall windows on the right, below the treetops, the green grass festival ground comes into view.

The airplane curves very gently to the RIGHT toward one open side window in that row, not toward the window at the far end of the corridor, and flies out sideways through it into bright open air at third-floor height; the camera follows it through the window frame.

The festival ground opens up below exactly like the third-floor festival reference: the food-truck lot directly below, the green air arch at the track gate, the grass pitch and the stage at the far end. Riding the breeze, the airplane glides smoothly and gradually down from third-floor height to second-floor height (about six metres), never dropping suddenly; the camera descends with it from behind.

At second-floor height the airplane flies along the LEFT side of the red track toward the far-end stage; a wide view of the whole festival: rows of white booth tents with students browsing, the chair blocks and the stage.

The airplane follows a slow gentle curve around the stage-end of the track and flies back down the RIGHT side of the track, gradually descending to just above head height; the camera keeps following from behind.
Just above head height the airplane glides over the colourful food trucks and the short queues of students in front of them, seen from above and behind.
It glides on over the lawn with red, green and orange bean bags where students sit and rest.
The airplane flies straight through the middle of the green inflatable air arch at the track gate; the camera passes through the arch right behind it.
It glides across the grass pitch just above the heads of students seated in the black chair blocks, heading straight for the stage.

The airplane rises smoothly over the white truss roof of the stage and climbs straight up into the deep blue sky; the camera tilts up following it, the frame fills with sky and sunlight and glows to pure white.
exit_state: The frame is entirely bright white light.
audio: diegetic only: soft corridor reverb, open-air wind as it leaves the window, a lively festival ambience below (distant chatter, gentle laughter, food-truck sizzle), paper flutter, a rising airy breeze as the light grows.
extra_negatives: no flying to the far end of the corridor
no change of the festival layout
no air arch on the grass
